non_claims: this receipt is [bounded] to the three approved reader fixtures and the single declared real input; it is not corpus coverage
the declared real input is one tracked bounded Consultant WordML fixture, not the restricted corpus (consru_export/exports/); no decoded legal text enters tracked evidence
counts and sha256 are integrity evidence, not coverage and not source authenticity
this is not a read-back verifier (S03), not a context export and not semantic/legal gold
R1000 stays active and unclosed; this receipt never auto-closes it
frozen oracles and the M213 cleaned wire bytes are not modified

proof_classes.block_binding: analysis blocks are reader primary views; block text is the ordered concatenation of source-fragment segments and each span localizes to exactly one fragment
proof_classes.bounded_real_input: the declared real input is pinned by byte length and sha256; only counts and hashes are recorded
proof_classes.coordinates: every bound record span resolves through the seam to the exact substrate UTF-8 slice; a bound span is a non-empty range
proof_classes.cross_fragment_refusal: a span that straddles two source fragments is a closed cross_fragment refusal, never rebased and never dropped
proof_classes.envelope: manifest/policies/records/footer shape, two recomputable non-cyclic seals and a closed completion marker
proof_classes.fail_closed: a document with records yields resolved typed members or explicit refused spans; a refused span forces completion=incomplete/refused_record and is never promoted
proof_classes.identity: the envelope parent pins the captured manifest sha256/bytes and both footer seals; check_parent_citation and check_document_version succeed on the pipeline's own output
proof_classes.no_corpus_transfer: fragment records are count/hash only; the envelope carries no inline decoded text
proof_classes.no_temporal_fields: no temporal stop-sign field enters the identity/coordinate envelope
proof_classes.unresolved_not_promoted: an unresolved typed member keeps TypeDerivation::Unresolved and an empty TYPE surface

re_test_set: cargo test -p ln-decode --offline --test npa_analysis_export_integration --test analysis_source_mapping_contract --test analysis_source_mapping_hostile --test analysis_source_mapping_integration --test npa_document_context_contract --test npa_document_context_hostile_contract --test npa_link_pipeline_integration --test cleaned_projection_verify
refusals_observed: cross_fragment: a whole-block span over two source-fragment segments
out_of_bounds: a local span beyond the block text
SourceIdentityMismatch: a tampered source sha256 and a claimed seal on an unsealed parent
DocumentVersionMismatch: a record revision differing from the envelope triple
CrossDocument: a fragment from another fixture pinned into this envelope
